description: A cut made entirely of prompts, which is what a preview costs nothing to watch. A sketch shot, then a stale one whose generated file is right there on disk and red — if state dispatch ever fell back to 'is there a file?', frame 20 would be a red plate instead of a card, which is the subtlest way this feature can break. A narration sketch bands the foot of the frame for its first 20 frames and then stops: frame 20 is where the card ends, so a narration card that outlived its clip, or never appeared, fails here too. Frames 0 and 14 are either side of nothing and pin the card itself — its panel, its VIDEO PROMPT / SKETCH label, and the prompt text wrapped on it. Drop the prompt and keep the panel and every frame here goes red.
